title: Cod in Smoky Velvety French Stew
description: A French-inspired stew featuring cod, velvety potatoes, and a smoky undertone. This hearty dish is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the fresh thyme sprig and bay leaves, cook for 1 minute.
Add the cod fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until browned.
Add the smoked paprika, white wine, and fish stock. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low.
Add the chopped potatoes and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the cod and potatoes in bowls, garnished with fresh thyme.
